meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求变成一份可直接动工的实施方案,动手前理清步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手写代码前,想先拿出一份清晰的实施计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough request into one decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan nailed down before writing any code.

howto.what: Claude 会切换成规划顾问:只做只读的探索、搜索和分析,不改产品代码、不派实现任务,只在 .omo/ 下写计划文件,最终交出一份下游可零追问执行的「决策完整」计划。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求走 ulw-plan 流程,或要求在动手实现前先出计划时接管;单独跑 ulw 不会自动激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划一下给 /login 加限流
say.note: 它会先探索,再给出计划,不动代码

say.text: 先别实现,给我一份决策完整的计划
say.note: 进入规划模式,你点头后才写计划

say.text: 这份计划要求高精度评审

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a planning consultant: read-only exploration, search and analysis, no product-code edits and no implementer subagents — it writes only plan files under .omo/ and hands over one decision-complete plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit request for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan per-IP rate limiting on /login
say_en.note: It explores first, then plans; no code changes

say_en.text: Don't implement yet — give me one decision-complete plan
say_en.note: Plan mode; the plan is written after you approve

say_en.text: Mark this plan for high-accuracy review
say_en.note: Sets review_required and runs plan-reviewer review
